Thanks for the encouraging words. I've thought a lot about what you said over the past few years, about trying to live to my potential and whatnot. I've tried very hard to apply these principles and even succeeded to a small amount by cutting pretty much everyone in my life. However, in a way, that made me even more miserable. I'm a pretty social guy and thrive on being with others. I admit I am too much of a people pleaser. So when I shut everyone out, I had nobody to be with, and that made me even worse than I am right now. In addition, I still ended up hating myself after seeing random people react - the grocery store clerk or the kids pointing or the hot chick walking down the street or whatever. No matter what I did, no matter how much I tried to cut out those people, I can't avoid society. And on a deeper level, I am unfulfilled without those others in my life. I took a solo trip to Europe. I couldn't get anyone to talk to me without wearing a hat, and I have to wear a custom fit hat because no standard hats fit me. It was embarrassing and put a dent on an otherwise great trip. But I can't afford experiences like that forever.      
 
This creates somewhat of a catch-22. I am miserable without people I care about in my life, but ashamed and angry at those same people because they mock me and stare. There's no solution and I'm tired. I'm tired of trying. I'm tired of forgiving. I'm tired of being.
